KO/EN/DE: fictional mutually agreed casual adult friendship versus polite/formal public meeting,6Thursday versus9Friday. Same exclamation gets explicit support/thanks versus blank criticism and declared non-praise; assesses contextual support, not TTS emotional authenticity. Intention question followed by burden-sharing offer, repair without blaming listener. Understanding excludes work takeover, nod/silence not full assent. Teacher honorification and hearsay preserved. Six required context/scope/register criteria; actual intonation/inner feelings unverified.

KO/EN/DE: separate long lecture context contrast→limits of prosodic inference→narrator versus character→relationship and repair. Distinguishes irony and cynicism without equating them universally, narrator-stated knowledge versus character inference, no interpersonal diagnosis. Three required structure/source/repair criteria. Delivery itself not certified as emotional prosody.

KO/EN/DE: original multi-paragraph literary dialogue plus two actual critiques and two EN/DE translation alternatives. Opening ambiguous praise/rebuke remains open, narrator knows pretence while character infers disregard; cooperative follow-up supports concern without proving pure intention. A adds certainty/direct verification absent from teacher-attendance hearsay; B preserves hearsay with explained honorific/register limits. Weekdays accurately translated Thursday/Donnerstag and Friday/Freitag; corrected name particles before review. Seven required interpretive/source/translation contrasts.

KO/EN/DE: three required complete texts, intimate reflection, public reflection with sentence-level distance notes, and critical argument with strongest objection/alternative reading. Preserve actual agreed relationship, third-person honorification, hearsay, unresolved responsibility and distinction among narrator/character/critic. Correct added certainty without asserting opposite intention; source-bound revision, no decorative hedging substitute. Meaning/style effects unscored.

KO/EN/DE: mutually agreed casual repair of perceived sarcasm preserves listener choice and facts, then polite colleague and formal meeting versions with teacher honorification/hearsay/open roles. Record same 네/는걸 in supportive/corrective contexts and replay pauses/focus; no automatic inner-state judgement. Korean mediation exclamation-to-certain-emotion/hearsay-to-assurance. Guardian-child stage 거라 not licensed as adult-peer command. Meaning/intonation/stance unscored.
